AO.title: Your company history might have a next chapter.
AO.pain: You have the records. You need to know whether they’re useful, what’s involved, and which rights you’d be giving up.
AO.quote:
I know we're a little under your typical minimum, but I hope the depth and
breadth of the archive earns a favorable review.
AO.description: Ask Rancher to discuss your existing archive: the history you have, the systems it lives in, and the rights and access you’re comfortable considering.

OS.title: You have an offer. You want the terms to make sense.
OS.pain: The headline fee isn’t the whole decision. Exclusivity, licensing rights and timing matter too.
OS.quote: We’re currently shopping it around to a number of services and would be happy to offer an exclusive for the right license fee, or a non-exclusive for a fair fee and terms.
OS.description: Ask about another estimate and discuss how non-exclusive and exclusive terms compare with the offer you’re considering.

MC.title: More than one company. More than one set of records.
MC.pain: You need a way to work through the companies separately, without losing sight of the bigger picture.
MC.quote: I don’t want to waste your time or mine but, I also don’t want to waste opportunities either.
MC.description: Discuss which companies to start with, what history each holds, and who can authorize access. Treat each company’s rights and records separately.
